newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar foreign minister makes official trip to Iran.
newsitem.headline: Qatar foreign minister makes official trip to Iran.

text.p: Qatar's Foreign Minister Sheikh Hamad bin Jassim bin Jabr al-Thani left Doha for Tehran on Saturday for an official one-day visit to the Islamic republic, the official Qatar News Agency said.
It gave no further details on the trip.
Qatar, a small oil and gas-rich country, regards non-Arab Iran as an important regional power with whom it maintains close political and economic relations.
Iran, whose influence in the region diminished after the 1979 fall of the late shah, has been trying to improve ties with Qatar and other Gulf Arab states.
In May Qatar politely declined an Iranian offer of a defence pact, saying it was not necessary at that stage.
